title: Implement centralized article ingress validation function
description:
Implement validate_article_ingress(article: &Article, config: &ValidationConfig) -> Result<(), ProtocolError> in core/src/validation.rs. Checks: all 6 mandatory RFC 5536 headers present, Message-ID format valid (<local@domain>), Date within +-24h of system time, Newsgroups contains only valid group names, all header fields <= 998 bytes, body size <= config.max_article_bytes. ValidationConfig is a small struct (max_article_bytes, allowed_groups: Option<Vec<GroupName>>). Artifact: core/src/validation.rs.

Acceptance criteria: each check is a separate code path with a unit test; each failure returns the correct ProtocolError variant; function is the single validation point called by both POST and IHAVE handlers; no duplicate validation logic elsewhere
